case_title: LIGHTNING EXPRESS C/O MORRIS PHILLIPS VS ARISTOTLE INDUSTRIES

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $670.00 FILED BY LIGHTNING EXPRESS C/O MORRIS PHILLIPS AS TO DEFENDANT ARISTOTLE INDUSTRIES ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-03-2003 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION APR-03-2003, CONTINUED BY COURT TO MAY-01-2003 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506 PLAINTIFF TO TIMELY SERVE & FILE PROOF OF SERVICE. DEFENDANT FAILED TO APPEAR.
SMALL CLAIMS DISPOSITION MAY-01-2003, CONTINUED BY COURT TO MAY-29-2003 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506 UNTIMELY SERVICE.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF LIGHTNING EXPRESS C/O MORRIS PHILLIPS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT ARISTOTLE INDUSTRIES $670.00 PRINCIPAL, $44.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $714.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
